summary: Iter56 — 10-digit tracking number + Code128 barcode on every custom-order brief. Backend 13/13 NEW pytest PASS (POST returns 10-digit numeric tracking_number, two-brief uniqueness, public GET /track/{n} returns 400 on bad/short/long/alpha, 404 on unknown, 200 with sanitised payload that EXCLUDES email/phone/description/admin_note/buyer_name, admin auth gate, admin 400 on bad format, admin lookup by tracking returns matching row, admin unknown returns []; Mongo backfill verified — 0 rows missing tracking_number out of 86 total, unique index on tracking_number present, all values are 10-digit numeric strings and globally unique). Backend regression 52/52 PASS (iter51+52+53+54+55). Frontend live-verified on preview: (a) /track/5233713298 → barcode SVG with 26 rects (data-testid=track-barcode-5233713298), 7 stages rendered (submitted/quoted/assigned/accepted/in_progress/won_bid/completed all present as track-stage-{key}), 'Submitted · CURRENT' marker correctly highlighted on the submitted row, 'Submitted 4/30/2026' header date rendered. (b) /track form invalid input '12345' → 'Tracking number must be 10 digits.' shown via track-error testid. (c) /track/0000000099 (unknown) → friendly 404 message 'We couldn't find a brief with that tracking number...' (d) Admin /admin/dashboard → Custom Orders tab → 82 brief-barcode-{order.id} testids rendered, top-right of each row, each with 26 rect bars and 10-digit number under bars. (e) Maker /maker/dashboard → Briefs tab → 1 brief-barcode-{brief.id} testid (won-bid brief 2656469497), 26 rect bars, top-right of card. PageErrors=0. One carry-over hydration warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' fires (not introduced by iter56 — documented in iter37; root cause is visual-editor x-* dev wrapper around <option> children of CustomOrdersList maker-select dropdown).

issues: Carry-over from iter54/55: hydration warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' still fires once on mount. Not introduced by iter56. Source: visual-editor dev tooling wraps <option> children with <span data-ve-dynamic> in CustomOrdersList.jsx maker-select. Likely dev-only. Already documented in iteration_37.json action_items.

critical_code_review_comments: [good] CustomOrder.tracking_number uses default_factory with 10 random digits via secrets.choice — leading-zero-safe, cryptographically random.
[good] catalog.create_custom_order has 5-attempt collision re-roll loop guarding the unique Mongo index — defensive even though 10B address space makes collision vanishingly unlikely.

[good] Public GET /custom-orders/track/{n} validates strictly with .isdigit() AND len==10 (rejects leading-zero-stripped ints, alpha, short, long); returns 400 'Invalid tracking number.' for malformed and 404 'Brief not found.' for missing — both exactly per spec.

[good] Public payload is whitelist-built (only 11 named fields explicitly returned) — no risk of accidental PII leakage even if model gains new fields. Tests confirmed email/phone/description/admin_note/name/buyer_name/budget all absent from response.

[good] Status derivation in public_track_brief correctly cascades: maker_response_status (won_bid > completed > in_progress > accepted > declined) → assigned_maker_slug (assigned) → status=='quoted' (quoted) → submitted (default). Lifecycle accurately reflected.

[good] Admin custom_orders accepts ?tracking= query, strict 10-digit validation matches public endpoint, query short-circuits to {tracking_number: tracking} so the existing pagination/sort still applies.
[good] Mongo unique index on tracking_number confirmed present (sparse to allow legacy null-safety), enforced at DB layer as belt-and-suspenders alongside app-level re-roll.
[good] Backfill complete — 0/86 rows missing tracking_number, all values are unique 10-digit numeric strings (verified via direct Mongo aggregation in pytest).

[good] Buyer confirmation email send_buyer_custom_ack now accepts tracking_number kwarg — tracking link surfaced in email body so buyers can return to /track/{n} (not directly tested but signature inspected).
[good] Frontend Barcode component uses jsbarcode Code128 with proper testId prop, ref-based SVG render, aria-label for a11y. Renders 26 rect bars per 10-digit value as expected.
[good] data-testid namespace consistent: track-barcode-{n} on /track, brief-barcode-{order.id} on admin + maker — 82+1 distinct testids rendered live.
[good] /track route registered for both /track and /track/:trackingNumber (App.js line ~152) — verified working both with and without param.
[minor·carry-over] Hydration warning <span> in <option> still fires (iter54 carry-over, NOT iter56).

success_rate.frontend: 100% — barcode rendered on all 3 surfaces (track/admin/maker), 7-stage timeline + CURRENT marker correct, form validation + 404 friendly message both correct, 0 page errors

Maker JWT for iron-and-oak via issue_magic_token + /api/maker/auth/verify, stored as cm_maker_jwt + cm_maker_slug='iron-and-oak'. Public /track endpoints required no auth.
